title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Abandons Its Defining Aspect & Stands On Its Own
content:
Solo Leveling on Crunchyroll has emerged as one of the most distinctive and popular series. What made the series truly amazing was undoubtedly Jinwoo’s journey. It started with Jinwoo as an E-Rank Hunter, the weakest in the nation; however, his kindness from the beginning made him an endearing character, while his sacrifice in the Double Dungeon arc, combined with his intellect, stole fans’ hearts and made them root for his growth. Solo Leveling then follows this desire, focusing on a journey of leveling up solo. So when a series like Tomb Raider King began serialization at the start of Summer 2026, fans naturally drew comparisons, as it featured many similarities to Solo Leveling .

Tomb Raider King incorporated many elements similar to Solo Leveling , featuring tombs that resemble the dungeons from Solo Leveling and the similarity of the main characters becoming increasingly powerful as they uncover more details about the strange phenomena in their worlds through the power of the systems bestowed upon them. However, as new episodes of Tomb Raider King were released, it proved to be far different from Solo Leveling , as the former completely eliminates the concept of solo leveling by featuring its protagonist, Seo Jooheon, who constantly seeks others’ help to execute his revenge plan.

Tomb Raider King Is No Longer a Replacement for Solo Leveling, but Its Own Anime

The first element that sets Tomb Raider King apart is undoubtedly the protagonists’ motivations. While Jinwoo wanted to become stronger for himself and his loved ones, Jooheon is simply on a quest for revenge and has no desire to become a hero. Jooheon suffered betrayal in the future, so his second chance at life is essentially about doing everything he can to seek justice for himself. He constantly seeks the help of others or even manipulates them whenever he gets the chance. He has done this so far with Irene Holton and the relic restorer, Jaeha. In the latest episode, he is now embarking on a quest to acquire a relic for someone important whom he recognizes from the future.

The “Queen of War” he is aiming to help is someone who gains immense power in the future, and he is doing her this favor so that he can become as powerful as possible. This reflects how he isn’t relying solely on his own abilities but is instead gathering as many allies as he can in his quest for revenge against Kwon Taejoon. This makes Tomb Raider King an anime about revenge , where the avenger will go to any length to achieve his goal. Meanwhile, Solo Leveling was about the main character leveling up alone to the point where the assistance of others was no longer required, standing as a hero at the peak all alone.

Yet, both anime are indeed so similar that you can’t help but compare the two. Still, it is encouraging to see Tomb Raider King emerging as its own anime despite borrowing similar concepts from Solo Leveling , and it will surely be a good watch for fans who want something similar to Solo Leveling while still offering its own nuances.

title: Attack on Titan: Brave Order Cooperative Smartphone Game Ends Service on September 28
content:
Sales of in-game currency have halted.

The game launched for iOS and Android devices in February 2022.

The game has players join the Scout Corps alongside Eren and Mikasa, and take down Titans cooperatively alongside other players.

Mobage released the first Shingeki no Kyojn ( Attack on Titan ) smartphone game in 2012. The Shingeki no Kyojin -Hangeki no Tsubasa- ( Attack on Titan : The Wings of Counterattack) smartphone game launched on the GREE mobile platform in 2013. The Shingeki no Kyoujin -Jiyū he no Hōkō- ( Attack on Titan -Call for Freedom-) smartphone game then launched through Mobage in 2014. DeNA released KAYAC 's Attack on Titan TACTICS tactical role-playing smartphone game for iOS and Android devices in English in September 2019, and the game ended service in August 2020.

title: Dragon Ball Super Confirms a Major Update For Manga’s Return
content:
The Dragon Ball Super manga has been on hiatus ever since Akira Toriyama’s death in March 2024. Written by Toriyama and illustrated by Toyotaro, the manga was released in 2015 as a sequel to the original story. Dragon Ball originally concluded its serialization in 1995, which is why its return two decades later was the most exciting surprise for fans. Thanks to the franchise’s global impact, it maintained a huge fan base even two decades after the main story’s ending. The sequel manga follows Goku and the others in a new set of adventures that take place after the Buu Saga, where Kid Buu was defeated. However, the manga has been on hiatus for more than two years, and fans are still waiting for Toyotaro to take over the helm.

In February last year, Toyotaro released a single chapter before continuing the hiatus. While the manga’s return date hasn’t been revealed yet, the official X handle of V Jump described it as a “serializing” work, confirming that Toyotaro will be returning with new chapters. The official account also recently reposted Toyotaro , who assured fans that he will return with the manga. The artist has big shoes to fill after Toriyama’s death, which is all the more reason a long break was necessary. However, after these latest updates, likely that Dragon Ball Super ‘s return is sooner than expected.

Dragon Ball Super Will Return With a New Anime Season

The anime debuted in 2015 as a long-running series and wrapped up the Tournament of Power Saga in 2018. Goku’s Ultra Instinct took the internet by storm , but unfortunately, the anime bid farewell to fans not long after that. After making fans wait for almost eight years, the anime confirmed a sequel season of the series. As the title suggests, Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol will adapt the Galactic Patrol Prisoner Saga of the manga that takes place after the Tournament of Power.

The anime hasn’t revealed a release window or a teaser yet, and it might take a while for it to be released. The next big project from the animation studio is the remake series, Dragon Ball Super: Beerus , which will begin airing in October as part of the Fall 2026 lineup. The remake aims to release a more faithful adaptation of Toriyama’s story with better animation.

Dragon Ball Super Needs to Return With a New Saga

The extra chapter released last year concluded the Super Hero Saga, so we can expect the manga to return with a brand new story. This also means a new adventure for Goku and the Z Fighters, so anything could happen after the series resumes its monthly serialization. With no release window or first look at the manga’s return so far, it’s impossible to determine how the story will proceed from here on out.

At the very least, we know that Goku and the Z Fighters will continue to face more powerful opponents as the story continues. The latest Saga of the series expands on the story of the 2022 film, Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero , centering around Piccolo and Gohan. This is all the more reason another arc with Goku at the center is needed as soon as the manga’s return.

title: OceanVeil Reveals September 11 Simulcast Debut of Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor Anime; English Dub of Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
content:
WWWave Corporation 's anime streaming platform OceanVeil announced on Friday the September 11 simulcast debut for the television anime of Okumaro 's Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I’m Gonna Click Away On The Girls! ( Mouse Cursor de Genjitsu o Sōsa Dekiru Yō ni Natta node, Onna no Ko o Ippai Click Shima~su , or Click Me All Over ) manga, and revealed the anime's main cast and staff members. In addition, OceanVeil also revealed the September 3 English dub debut, and English dub cast for the television anime of Rin Komugi 's Marika's Love Meter Malfunction ( Marika-chan no Kōkando wa Bukkowareteiru ) manga.

OceanVeil describes Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I’m Gonna Click Away On The Girls! anime's story:

Takumi, an ordinary otaku , is sitting in IT class when he notices something impossible: his computer mouse cursor has sprung right out of the screen and into the real world! Panicked, he asks his bossy childhood friend Mone if she can see it, but she just brushes him off. Realizing the cursor is completely invisible to others and under his control, Takumi decides to test it out by slipping it between the gaps in Mone's clothes and clicking away! As Mone writhes from the unfamiliar sensation, Takumi uncovers a floating real-life context menu featuring incredible controls like "Cut", "Paste", "Double Sensitivity Mode", and even "The Real Deal" (if he can earn enough Click Points!). But keeping his new powers a secret isn't easy. Between accidental wardrobe malfunctions caused by 'Cut', mysterious classmates pursuing him, and art club presidents who might actually see the cursor, Takumi's clicking spree is about to set off a wild, slapstick chain reaction!

AnimeFesta revealed a promotional video for the anime earlier on Friday.

The anime will star:

• Jigokubozu as Takumi Matsuo / Young Takumi

• Ruka Fujihira as Mone Himeno / Young Mone

• Yuki Fujimiya as Mirei Aida

• Shigo no Lady as Kaoru Nishimiya

• Masyumaro Ayanokoji as teacher

• Konbu Ariake as female student

Kazuya Nakamura is the anime's planning and executive producer, Reiga Goto is the producer, Studio Hōkiboshi is producing the anime, and Suiseisha is credited for production. Makoto Sokuza is the director, Eeyo Kurosaki is overseeing the series scripts, Minakawa Akapiv is the character designer, and Harimasu is the chief animation director.

Other staff members include:

• Color Designer: Saito

• Art Setting and Art Director: Chan Do Kim Fan

• Director of Photography: Shintaro Kojima

• Editing: Kōki Shinkai

• Sound Director: Mikumo Amakuwa

• Sound Producer: Studio Mouse

The anime will be part of the AnimeFesta programming block in Japan. The anime will debut on television in Japan on October 4 at 25:00 (effectively October 5 at 1:00 a.m.) on Tokyo MX and BS11 . The anime will begin streaming in Japan earlier on AnimeFesta starting on September 11.

Okumaro began serializing the manga on the ComicFesta service in March 2024, and Suiseisha published the third compiled book volume on April 17. Suiseisha will publish the manga's fourth volume on September 18. Coolmic is publishing the manga in English under the title Click Me All Over .

The English dub of Marika's Love Meter Malfunction anime will debut on OceanVeil on September 3 at 10:00 a.m. PDT (1:00 p.m. EDT).

The English dub cast members are:

• Ciarán Strange as Kanata Kitami

• Kelsey Jaffer as Marika Chitose

• Darcey Lee as Sayuki Toyotomi

• Caroline Orejeula as Niino Hidaka

• Katy Johnson as Kokona Mikasa

• Steve Warky Nunez as Narrator

The anime streamed early in Japan on AnimeFesta on March 13, with the "on-air version" (as opposed to the uncut version) free to stream. OceanVeil also simultaneously streamed the anime in advance. The anime then ran on the Tokyo MX and BS11 television channels on April 5.

OceanVeil desccribes the anime:

Kanata Kitami is a timid high school loner with a massive, unspoken crush on his super popular childhood friend, Marika Chitose. Desperate for a hint and wishing his life was more like a love simulation game, Kanata makes a wish upon a shooting star to better understand women. The next morning, his wish comes true: floating "love meters" suddenly appear beside every girl he encounters! There's just one massive problem: Marika's love meter is completely broken—sitting in the negatives and having a total meltdown! Convinced that his dream girl secretly despises him despite her sweet demeanor, Kanata completely misinterprets the situation. In reality, Marika's love for him is so overwhelmingly intense—featuring phone lock screens of him and an entire room secretly plastered with his photos—that her affection literally broke the meter! As Kanata tries to navigate the glitched UI and the unexpectedly rising love meters of his other female classmates, a wild, heartwarming, and secret-filled romantic comedy unfolds.

The manga launched in 2024, and Suiseisha has been publishing the manga digitally. Suiseisha started publishing the manga in print with the first and second volumes on April 17. The third volume debuted on June 18. WWWave Corporation publishes the manga in English on its Coolmic platform.

title: Studio Aardman's Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd and Pichu Stop-Motion Series Reveals Teaser Trailer, 2027 Debut on Disney+, Disney XD
content:
The official website for the Pokémon franchise announced during the PokémonXP event on Friday that Disney+ will exclusively stream the Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd and Pichu , the franchise 's stop-motion animated series collaboration with independent studio Aardman ( Wallace & Gromit , Shaun the Sheep ), beginning in 2027. The Disney XD channel will debut the series on television. The official YouTube channels for the Pokémon franchise and Aardman unveiled a teaser trailer:

The series is part of a global distribution deal between Disney+ and The Pokémon Company International . The deal also includes Pokémon the Series: The Beginning , the original Indigo League season of the anime, which began streaming on Disney+ on August 7 with the first 27 episodes and has also begun airing on Disney XD .

Peter Lord, Cofounder and Creative Director at Aardman , stated that the Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd and Pichu animated series will take place in a region that is "very close to our hearts." The video teases Wooloo and Sirfetch'd, which are Pokémon originally introduced in the Pokémon Sword/Shield games that are set in the Galar region based on the U.K.

Tom Parkinson is the director, Natalie McKay is the creative director, and James Young is the creative lead.

Pokémon Concierge , another stop-motion animated series for the Pokémon franchise , debuted with four episodes on Netflix in December 2023. The stop-motion production company dwarf studios ( Rilakkuma and Kaoru ) animated the episodes thus far. New episodes premiered in September 2025.''

The Pokémon: Horizons anime premiered in Japan in April 2023 with a one-hour first-episode special. The show airs in Japan on Fridays at 6:55 p.m. JST.

The Pokémon Company had originally announced that the anime would debut on Netflix in the U.S. in February 2024, but the series debuted instead in March 2024. Netflix premiered Pokémon Horizons: The Series —The Search for Laqua , the anime's second season, in February 2025. Netflix added Pokémon Horizons: Season 3—Rising Hope on January 6.

title: Disney+ Reveals Surprising Details For Exclusive Pokémon Anime
content:
Pokémon might have started as a video game, but the story of the pocket monsters has taken over multiple media. Perhaps as big as the Nintendo entries over the years, the series has netted thousands of anime episodes by exploring the world of Pokémon and its trainers. Even with Ash Ketchum and Pikachu leaving the series, the show refuses to end. Next year, not only is Disney planning to release a new kind of Pokemon series on its streaming service, but it will be unlike anything that has come from the franchise before.

Announced earlier this year, Aardman Animation is planning to create a stop-motion animated series titled Pokemon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch’d & Pichu . At this year’s Pokemon XP, “the first-ever official fan convention” for the franchise, Disney revealed that the series will be exclusive to Disney+ in 2027. On top of this, it was also confirmed that the upcoming series will be a comedy with zero dialogue, as neither Pichu nor Sirfetch’d will have any words to share. The series will be based on the Nintendo video game Pokémon: Sword and Shield , while every set and character will be made entirely by hand by 262 animators. With Aardman well known for creating works for franchises like Star Wars and Over the Garden Wall , they’ve certainly earned their reputation. You can check out a new look at the 2027 series below.

Pokemon’s Vast Horizons

Disney+ might be the exclusive place to watch next year’s Aardman collaboration , but it is far from the only platform to house the entire anime franchise. In fact, several different streaming services house multiple episodes, making it sometimes difficult for Pokémon fans to know just how they can check out the entirety of the series. Streamers like Netflix, Hulu, Tubi, Amazon Prime Video, and Pluto TV , to name a few, house batches of episodes, making the ability to track them all down quite a difficult task. When it comes to the latest anime series, however, only one platform has been following Liko and Roy.

Pokemon Horizons has been an exclusive to Netflix , acting as the first anime series that continued the universe following Ash and Pikachu’s departure. While new protagonists aren’t attempting to become the world’s greatest trainers like Ketchum had, they are facing challenges that might have even given Ash a run for his money. Earlier this summer, the latest batch of anime episodes landed on Netflix, with new installments releasing regularly in Japan. It might be some time before we see the next season hit the streaming service, but since Horizons isn’t hinting at a grand finale anytime soon, we might be in for quite the long future with this latest anime take on the pocket monster world.

The series will be based on the Nintendo video game Pokémon: Sword and Shield , while every set and character will be made entirely by hand by 262 animators. With Aardman well known for creating works for franchises like Star Wars and Over the Garden Wall , they’ve certainly earned their reputation. You can check out a new look at the 2027 series below.
Pokemon’s Vast Horizons

Disney+ might be the exclusive place to watch next year’s Aardman collaboration , but it is far from the only platform to house the entire anime franchise. In fact, several different streaming services house multiple episodes, making it sometimes difficult for Pokémon fans to know just how they can check out the entirety of the series. Streamers like Netflix, Hulu, Tubi, Amazon Prime Video, and Pluto TV , to name a few, house batches of episodes, making the ability to track them all down quite a difficult task. When it comes to the latest anime series, however, only one platform has been following Liko and Roy.

Pokemon Horizons has been an exclusive to Netflix , acting as the first anime series that continued the universe following Ash and Pikachu’s departure. While new protagonists aren’t attempting to become the world’s greatest trainers like Ketchum had, they are facing challenges that might have even given Ash a run for his money. Earlier this summer, the latest batch of anime episodes landed on Netflix, with new installments releasing regularly in Japan. It might be some time before we see the next season hit the streaming service, but since Horizons isn’t hinting at a grand finale anytime soon, we might be in for quite the long future with this latest anime take on the pocket monster world.

title: RetroCrush Adds Several Anime Series, Films from Viz Including Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow
content:
RetroCrush announced on Thursday that it will add the following anime films and anime series from Viz Media to its service:

• Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow

• Sailor Moon R: The Movie

• Bleach the Movie: Hell Verse

• Hunter × Hunter: Phantom Rouge

• Hikaru no Go

• Accel World

• Captain Tsubasa

• Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

• Vampire Knight

Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow premiered in Japan in August 2004.

Sailor Moon R: The Movie opened in Japan in 1993.

Bleach manga creator Tite Kubo personally oversaw the production on Bleach the Movie: Hell Verse ( Bleach: Jigoku-hen ), which opened in Japan in December 2010.

Hunter × Hunter: Phantom Rouge opened in Japan in January 2013, and ranked #1 on its opening weekend.

Hikaru no Go aired from October 2001 to March 2003.

The anime adaptation of Reki Kawahara 's Accel World science-fiction light novel series premiered in April 2012.

The 2018-2019 Captain Tsubasa anime premiered in April 2018 on TV Tokyo and other stations. The anime retells the story of Yōichi Takahashi 's original manga from the beginning. The anime ended in its 52nd episode in April 2019. The anime got a second season titled Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc ( Captain Tsubasa Season 2: Juniors-hen ) that premiered on TV Tokyo and its affiliates in October 2023.

The Vampire Knight anime series debuted in April 2008.

title: Yang Can't Live Alone Manga Switches Publishers
content:
Square Enix will no longer publish physical copies of the manga in Japan, but the books will remain in stores until stock runs out. Digital distribution with the company will end on August 31 at 11:59 p.m. JST.

sooncha states that sales of translated versions will remain available until the end of their respective publishing agreements. As of press time, Square Enix Manga & Books ' page for the manga shows an error. ANN has contacted the company to confirm the manga's status in English. Manga UP! Global will end English digital distribution on August 31 at 11:59 p.m. JST. Manga chapters will remain available to view for customers who purchased them.

sooncha had previously stated that the manga's cancellation was due to a breakdown in their relationship with Manga UP! The series ended on the service with the third part of the 15th chapter on August 13. sooncha had added at the time that they were in talks with the editorial department to get Square Enix to withdraw the copyright.

The manga's third compiled book volume shipped on August 6. However, sooncha had asked people to cancel their pre-orders of the new volume if they were uncomfortable.

Manga UP! Global published the series digitally in English. Square Enix Manga & Books had also licensed the manga, and it originally announced that it would release the first volume in English on September 15. The company describes the story:

A serious college student and a friendly Chinese exchange student find the answer to love problems in each other! Yuu is as industrious and hardworking as a college student can be, but that means guys tend to find her serious demeanor intimidating. Should she have to change her strong-willed personality to be "number one" in someone's heart? Yang is a puppy-like Chinese exchange student who wanders into Yuu's life after she rescues him from a tricky situation. He asks her to be his bodyguard, and they form a new "professional" relationship. But soon, deeper feelings begin to take root...

sooncha launched the manga on Manga UP! in December 2024.

title: Yugo Aosaki's Rock Paper Landmine Novel Gets Live-Action Series With Worldwide Distribution on Amazon Prime Video
content:
Amazon Prime Video announced on Monday that Yugo Aosaki 's Jirai Glico ( Glico with Landmines ) novel is getting a live-action adaptation titled Rock Paper Landmine that will stream on the service worldwide starting on November 13.

The show will star Nana Mori as Mato Imoriya and Aju Makita as Kazahi Koda.

Kazuaki Seki is directing the series. Tatsuhiro Mishima, Shiori Ueno, and Daiki Kobayashi are writing the scripts, and Yuma Yamaguchi is composing the music. The Seven is producing the series and Akira Morii is the producer.

Kadokawa published the original novel in November 2023. The novel won three awards in 2024: the novel division of the 24th "Honkaku Mystery Taisho" (Orthodox Mystery Award) award, the "full-length novel or collected short stories" division of the 77th "Nihon Suiri Sakka Kyōkai Shō" (Mystery Writers of Japan Awards) award, and the 37th "Yamamoto Shūgorō Prize" award.

The Seven describes the story:

"Rock-Paper-Scissors," "Memory"... universally known simple games transform into the ultimate battles of strategy and psychology with just a few added rules! Mato Imoriya, a seemingly carefree high school girl with an uncanny talent for winning any game, plunges into underground school game battles to save her best friend, Kazahi Koda. What they stake isn't their "lives." It is their urgent "everyday lives" and "youth"—from securing prime spots for school festival booths to competing for 90 million yen worth of chips among students. High-level logic where a single step can be fatal, off-board tactics to outwit each other, and brilliant turnarounds that calmly flip the board from desperate situations. A "bloodless survival game" by high school girls who risk losing all their youth instead of their lives. The curtain rises on a thrilling, high-stakes battle-of-wits drama combining unpredictable tension with the catharsis of completely outwitting opponents!

Medaka Box artist Akira Akatsuki launched a manga adaptation of the novels in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine October 2024. The manga is ongoing and Hakusensha published the fourth volume on May 29.

Yugo Aosaki 's Undead Girl Murder Farce novels launched in 2015. Kodansha published the novel's third volume in April 2021. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the novels' manga adaptation. The novels inspired a television anime adaptation that debuted in July 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series worldwide excluding Asia as it aired in Japan under the title Undead Murder Farce .
